verdict.rationale: Alacritty documents its own IPC channel (`alacritty msg`), but the only documented command is `create-window`. Most UI-driven actions, such as vi mode, search, selection, hints and URL opening, are shown only as keybindings and mouse interactions, so a programmatic surface matching the UI is not established. Missing for 10: IPC coverage of search, selection, scrollback, hints and config changes; documentation of the full set of `alacritty msg` commands; any stated goal of API/UI parity; independent corroboration of scripted control.
